resources.string: Photo Sync
Photo Sync needs to see your photographs
It reads the camera roll to work out what the computer does not have yet. Nothing leaves this phone until you tap Start.
Continue
Without it there is nothing this application can do. You can grant it in Settings.

Let Photo Sync tidy up for you
Android asks again for every photograph unless you allow this once. Without it, freeing up space means confirming each file by hand.
Allow

Let it finish while the screen is off
Android pauses apps in the background. Without this, a long transfer stops when you put the phone down.
Allow
One more, for this phone
%1$s phones stop background apps harder than Android asks them to. These settings are the ones that catch people out:
Open settings
Done
Apps → Photo Sync → turn Autostart on. Battery saver → No restrictions. In Recents, pull the card down and lock it.
Battery → Allow background running. App management → Photo Sync → Auto-launch on. Lock it in Recents.
Battery → Battery optimisation → Photo Sync → Don\'t optimise. Advanced optimisation → Deep optimisation off.
Battery → High background power consumption → allow Photo Sync. iManager → App manager → Autostart.
Battery → Background usage limits → Never sleeping apps → add Photo Sync.
